title: The Long Stride
teaser: Twelve muddy footprints lead away from the boathouse. Everyone at the club wears the same shoes. Not everyone has the same legs.

booklet.briefing:
The Founders' Cup is a solid silver trophy that has stood on the boathouse shelf for ninety years. On Sunday it disappeared just after dawn.

The rain stopped at 5:30 am, leaving the towpath outside the boathouse soft and muddy. A trail of twelve footprints leads from the boathouse side door along the towpath to the gravel car park, where they stop.

Every club member owns the same club-issue trainers, so the tread pattern alone won't help. Mr. Foxy has borrowed a tape measure.
rules: The cup was taken between 6:00 am and 6:30 am.
The footprints were made by the thief. Nobody else used the side door or the towpath that morning (the groundsman watched the car park from his hut).

suspects.name: Juno Kim
suspects.description: Small, loud and in charge of steering the boat. 171 cm tall. Shoe size 7.
suspects.motive: Was dropped from the first boat last month.
suspects.statement: I got here at quarter past six and went straight to the changing room.

suspects.name: Callum Reid
suspects.description: The club's best rower. 179 cm tall. Shoe size 10.
suspects.motive: Behind on payments for his new racing boat.
suspects.statement: I was warming up on the jetty from six. I didn't go into the boathouse until the others arrived.

suspects.name: Darius Obi
suspects.description: Joined this year. 181 cm tall. Shoe size 10.
suspects.motive: Has said the old cup 'belongs in a museum, not on a shelf'.
suspects.statement: I was on the rowing machine in the gym from ten past six. Ask the coach.

suspects.name: Bryony Wexley
suspects.description: Former Olympic rower. 188 cm tall. Shoe size 10.
suspects.motive: The club committee voted against renewing her contract.
suspects.statement: I opened up at six and was in the gym setting up the machines. Darius was there with me.

evidence.title: The trail of prints
evidence.body:
Twelve clear prints from the side door to the car park. Size 10, club-issue tread.

Every print shows a full heel, then the toe, pressed evenly. The prints are evenly spaced. The walker was walking, not running.

Step length (heel of one print to the heel of the next): 73, 75, 74, 74, 73, 75, 74, 74, 75, 73, 74 cm. Average: 74 cm.

evidence.title: Footprint guide
evidence.body:
For an adult walking at a normal pace on level ground:

Height ≈ step length ÷ 0.415

Allow 5 cm either way. Do not use this for running prints.

evidence.title: Gym rowing machine
evidence.body:
User: D. Obi (logged in with his own heart-rate strap).

Session: 6:10 am to 6:41 am, no pauses longer than 20 seconds. Heart rate recorded throughout.

The gym is on the far side of the clubhouse from the boathouse, a 3-minute walk.

evidence.title: The groundsman
evidence.source: From his hut by the car park
evidence.body:
“Callum's car was here before six. Juno came on her bike at quarter past.”

“At about twenty past six somebody tall came off the towpath onto the gravel, walking quickly with a sports bag. I only saw their back. Club jacket, hood up.”

evidence.body:
In the boot, wrapped in a club towel: the Founders' Cup.

On the boot mat: smears of towpath mud.

questions.prompt: Using the guide, about how tall is the thief? (Whole centimetres.)
questions.explanation: 74 ÷ 0.415 = 178.3 cm. Allowing 5 cm either way, the thief is between about 173 and 183 cm tall.
hints: The guide gives you a formula. You have the step length already.
It's a little over 178. Remember to allow 5 cm either way for the next question.

questions.prompt: Which two suspects are inside that height range?
questions.explanation: 173 to 183 cm takes in Callum (179) and Darius (181). Juno (171) is too short and her feet are size 7. Bryony (188) is too tall.
hints: Turn your answer into a range: 5 cm below to 5 cm above.
Check each suspect's height against 173 to 183 cm. Check shoe sizes too.
Two rowers fit. The coach is too tall and the cox is too short.

solution.explanation: Callum Reid arrived early, let himself in through the boathouse side door and lifted the Founders' Cup into his sports bag. He walked briskly down the muddy towpath to his car and hid the cup in the boot under a club towel. He thought identical club trainers made him invisible, but the length of his stride put his height at about 178 cm, and only two members are that tall.

chain.step: The prints are walking prints with an average step of 74 cm.
74 ÷ 0.415 = 178 cm, so the thief is about 173 to 183 cm tall.
That fits Callum (179) and Darius (181) only.
Darius was on a logged rowing machine without a break from 6:10 to 6:41.
Callum's car was there before six, a tall figure left the towpath at about 6:20, and the cup was in his boot.
